- `Ckpt`: mmap'd safetensors file, `t()` looks up tensor, `data()` returns pointer into mapped region, `bytes()` reads via `read_tensor`, `f32()` converts F32/BF16 to fp32.
- `load()`: loads embed_norm, norm, final_query, embed (host BF16), unembed, middle_cycle_cross_pass_queries/kv_queries → msg_queries, expert_memory(), then per-layer: proj stack (wq, gate_attn, wr, sink_proj, wk, [k_sconv.weight_proj], wv, [v_sconv.weight_proj]), wo, router, router_bias, q_scale, rel_scale, rel_proj, attn_conv, mlp_conv, mlp_norm, full-layer extras (k_static, v_static, q_norm, k_norm, v_norm) or non-full (k_conv, v_conv, attn_norm), attn_query (l>0), mlp_query, loop gates (down_weight, forget/gain stack), experts (interleaved into slots, pool_nv/pool_mx), NVFP4 factors (f13, f2).
- `expert_memory()`: resident (device pools) or offload (host regions per NUMA node, mapped). Lazy experts for CPU offload: file-backed, CPU mis
